result.topic_en: Derivation of a mean-value formula for solutions of the Helmholtz equation Δu + αu = 0 (relating u at the centre to its mean over a sphere of radius ρ) via Green's theorem in spherical coordinates and a power-series solution of the radial equation.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z^2}+\alpha u=0$ $\quad 4\pi u_0=\frac{\rho\alpha}{\sin \rho\sqrt\alpha}\int u\,d\Pi$
[-$\int\left(\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}\ldots\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x}\right)ds=\int$-]
$\int\left(\frac{\partial X}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial Y}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial Z}{\partial z}\right)dS=-\int\left(X\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}+Y\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}+Z\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}\right)ds$
$X=u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x}-u'\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$\int u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p}ds-\int u'\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}ds=0$
$\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right)^2+\left(\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial u}{\partial \varphi}\right)^2+\frac{1}{r^2\sin^2\varphi}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\psi}\right)^2\right)r^2$ [-$dx$ $dy$-] $\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\,d\psi\,dr$
$\frac{\partial\, r^2\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}}{r^2\partial r}+\frac{\partial \sin\varphi\frac{\partial u}{\partial\varphi}}{r^2\sin\varphi\,\partial\varphi}+\frac{1}{r^2\sin\varphi^2}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\psi^2}=\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z^2}$
$\frac{\partial\, r^2\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}}{r^2\partial r}+\alpha u=0$ $\quad u=\sum a_m r^m$ $\quad \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z^2}+\alpha u=0$
$\sum m(m+1)a_m r^{m-2}+\alpha\sum a_{m-2}r^{m-2}=0$
$\frac{\Pi(m+1)a_m}{(-\alpha)^{\frac m2}}=\frac{\Pi(m-1)a_{m-2}}{(-\alpha)^{\frac m2-1}}=c$ $\quad$ {+$+\sin\rho\sqrt\alpha$ [-$\int u$-] $4\pi u_0$+}
$a_m r^m=c\sum\frac{r^m(-\alpha)^{\frac m2}}{\Pi\, m+1}$ $\quad 4\pi u_0=\frac{\rho\sqrt\alpha}{\sin\rho\sqrt\alpha}\int u\,d\Pi$
[-$+\int u\ldots d\Pi$-]
$\frac1r\cos r\sqrt\alpha$ $\quad u'=\frac1r\sin(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha$
$\int u\,d\Pi\left(\sin(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha-r\sqrt\alpha\cos(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha\right)$
$\frac1r e^{r\sqrt{-\alpha}}$
$+\int\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}d\Pi\, r\sin(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha$ [-$\int\sin\varphi\,d\varphi\,d\psi$-]
[-$-e^{r\sqrt{-\alpha}}+r\sqrt{-\alpha}\,e^{r\sqrt{-\alpha}}$-]
[-$-\alpha r e^{\ldots}$-]
$-e^{r\sqrt{-\alpha}}+r\sqrt{-\alpha}\,e^{r\sqrt{-\alpha}}$
$-\sin(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha+\frac{r}{\rho}$[?]$\cos(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha$
$\int u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial r}r^2d\Pi$
$\int u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial p}ds-\int u'\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}ds+\int u\frac{\partial u'}{\partial r}r^2d\Pi-\int u'\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}r^2d\Pi$
$r\sin(r-\rho)\int\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}d\Pi-\sin(r-\rho)\sqrt\alpha\int u\,d\Pi$
